text: Here, the mind is of a dual nature: it is like the intellect (buddhi) in the case of the cognitive faculties (indriyas), and like the motor faculties (karmendriyas) in the case of the motor faculties. Why? Because it is posited to initiate the activity of the intellect and also that of the motor faculties. Therefore, the mind is called the “initiator” (sankalpakam), as it initiates (sankalpayati) both.
